versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the webperf skill: a toolkit for measuring and debugging web performance.
- Provides 47 JavaScript snippets for Chrome DevTools covering Core Web Vitals, loading, interaction, media, and resource/network quality.
- Includes detailed guidance on which skill to use based on common user requests (e.g., "debug LCP", "audit images").
- Outlines a step-by-step workflow for running audits and interpreting results within Chrome DevTools.
- Open source under the MIT license and maintained by Joan Leon (@nucliweb).
